description: Change an organisation egress allowlist domain or description, potentially changing trusted outbound destinations. Inspect get_egress_allowlist_entry first. Omitted fields stay unchanged; description null clears it. At least one changed field is required. Returns Portkey's acknowledgement; requires organisation permission.

description.description: Optional description (up to 500 characters); null clears it

domain.description: Exact hostname, IPv4/IPv6 literal (optionally bracketed), or *. wildcard. No scheme, path, credentials, or port. Portkey trims/lowercases it and rejects cloud-metadata destinations

id.description: Egress allowlist entry UUID from list_egress_allowlist or create_egress_allowlist_entry

name: update_egress_allowlist_entry

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
